about: Hours, overnight rules and extra fees for Kentucky parks from each park's official page (research round 7, Oct 25 2026; rows without a source link left out). Not re-checked park by park: confirm on the linked page. Kentucky State Parks charge no general entry fee; that is a statewide note, not a per-park fact.
feeNote: Kentucky State Parks charge no general entry fee; camping, lodging, golf, museums and tours can cost extra.
